I've seen the research on teen mental health, political polarization, and how engagement-optimized algorithms reward outrage. The benefits people point to — staying connected, organizing, finding community — are real, but I think they're outweighed by the costs. If you want to argue that trade-off with me, I'm in. But social proof alone isn't going to move me.
